audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it directly: Aurora wins 46.96% over 839 games — the largest sample in her top-lane set — yet the chart gave Aurora 4 stages and Zaahen zero.
audit.why: The chart was built on one false premise, that Across the Veil dodges his engage. Aureate Rush (E) is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and Dreaded Return (W) is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s at 850 range with a pull; Across the Veil is 22/21/20/19/18s. Two engages on roughly half the cooldown of one escape means Levels 3 onward are not free. Levels 4-5 belong to Zaahen once The Darkin Glaive (6/5.5/5/4.5/4s at max rank, 10s at rank 1) is healing every trade back and Determination is stacking AD, and Level 6 belongs to him because Grim Deliverance (110/95/80s) heals off its own damage and Determination can revive him.
audit.corrected: Chart set as one atomic group to Skill / Aurora / Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen / Aurora / Skill, ratings 5/7/5/3/3/7/5. Aurora keeps Level 2 and first item, which the range advantage genuinely earns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer spike, cooldown and trade line said the literal word 'Ultimate' as if it were an ability name — tldr, winCon, enemyWin, focus.text, breakdown.early/mid/cooldowns/trading/difficulty, loading, dosFull and report all carried it. focus.letters pointed at R.
audit.why: Zaahen's ultimate is Grim Deliverance and it is not the spike that decides this lane. The lane spikes are Aureate Rush and Dreaded Return coming online, The Darkin Glaive's sustain at 4-5, and Aurora's first AP item. Riot Data Dragon gives all five real names: Cultivation of War, The Darkin Glaive, Dreaded Return, Aureate Rush, Grim Deliverance.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written throughout; focus retargeted to Aureate Rush (E).

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions that decide the matchup were absent everywhere: Dreaded Return is a PULL, Cultivation of War can REVIVE him, and Aureate Rush deals percent-health damage.
audit.why: Riot's text: Dreaded Return stabs then pulls enemies toward him (850 range) — so 'stay out of his dash range' is not enough, he has a second, longer-reaching engage that drags you in. Cultivation of War: when filled with Determination he gains AD and can revive, so a burst kill is not a banked kill. Aureate Rush is flagged percentHealth, which champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json also raises as resistances-invalidated.
audit.corrected: The pull, the revive and the percent-health damage are now stated in enemyWin, phases[4], dontsFull[0], dontsFull[1] and the content late text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block named no spell and no number, and the one sequencing claim it made — 'the W blink invalidates his E engage' — was wrong.
audit.why: Across the Veil (22s) is roughly double Aureate Rush (10s). You cannot dodge every engage; the correct advice is to hold the blink for his commit and accept chip.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block, spikes[1].text, whys[2] and early now carry 10s / 14s / 22s explicitly and say outright that you cannot beat both.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere against a champion who heals on two spells.
audit.why: The Darkin Glaive (Q) heals on a 10s rank-1 cooldown and Grim Deliverance (R) heals for a portion of damage dealt; champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json flags this matchup needs-antiheal.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal is now the stated buy in tldr, winCon, phases[3], tradeBad, dosFull[1] and spikes[2].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name 'Between the Worlds' in phases[4].why and breakdown.late.

notes: This was the worst matchup in the slice: 839 games, the packet's own defect line called the chart out, and the full layer used the literal string 'Ultimate' as Zaahen's ability name in eleven places. Kit-data caveats: The Darkin Glaive (Q) and Aureate Rush (E) both list range 25000 in Riot's data, which is a self-cast/no-range marker rather than a real 25000-unit reach — I did not quote either as a range anywhere, and only Dreaded Return's 850 is written as a distance. The Darkin Glaive's recast knock-up and auto-reset are in Riot's text and are used; whether Aurora's Between Worlds can be used to escape the Dreaded Return pull mid-displacement is NOT in the data and I did not claim it. Determination's revive threshold and duration are also not in Riot's text, so I wrote only 'can revive' without numbers. focus.text is 15 characters before the edit, so apply-proposals.js may skip it under the 25-character rule; focus.letters[0] carries the real fix.
